title: Delete an enabled brand hashtag for a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete enabled hashtags for a TikTok account. ## Before you start - Ensure the TikTok account is a TikTok Account with Advanced Access or Verified Business Account. Learn more [about TikTok account entitlements](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-tiktok-account-entitlements). To confirm this, use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) and check whether the response parameter `has_advanced_access` is `true` for the TikTok account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/hashtag/remove/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok accounts.

To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request message type.
Allowed value: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |business_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

You can get the ID through the `open_id` field returned by [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| | username {Required} | string | The username (handle) of the TikTok account. | | hashtag {Required} | string | A hashtag to remove.

To obtain a list of existing enabled hashtags for the brand, use [/business/mention/hashtag/manage/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833832557996034).

Note: You can only delete hashtags that were enabled at least seven days ago. To ensure this, check the returned `create_date` for the hashtags from [/business/mention/hashtag/manage/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833832557996034). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/hashtag/remove/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id":"{{business_id}}", "username":"{{username}}", "hashtag":"{{hashtag}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
